jobs.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Als Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d)
entwickelst du intelligente und skalierbare KI Lösungen für unsere Kunden.

Du begleitest wertvolle Anwendungsfälle von der ersten Idee über Prototyp und Pilot bis in den sicheren produktiven Betrieb. Im Zentrum stehen Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services
sowie die Integration von Unternehmensdaten, Prozessen und bestehenden Plattformen.

Was du bei uns machst

Konzeption, Entwicklung und Betrieb intelligenter Agenten und Multi Agent Lösungen mit Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Design und Implementierung generativer KI Lösungen mit Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI und weiteren Azure AI Services.
Entwicklung passender Lösungsarchitekturen einschließlich Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Anbindung von Unternehmensdaten.
Integration von Connectors, APIs, Microsoft 365, Power Platform und weiteren Unternehmenssystemen.
Durchführung technischer Discovery Workshops sowie Umsetzung von Prototypen, Proof of Value, Pilotprojekten und produktionsreifen Lösungen.
Mitgestaltung unseres Agent as a Service Angebots sowie Beratung zu Sicherheit, Governance, Responsible AI, Betrieb und Skalierung.

Wann du zu uns passt

Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Agenten mit Microsoft Copilot Studio und idealerweise in der Umsetzung von Multi Agent Szenarien.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services oder vergleichbaren Plattformen für generative KI.
Technisches Verständnis für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Datenintegration.
Erfahrung mit Power Platform, Connectors, REST APIs, Automatisierung und Enterprise Architekturen.
Kenntnisse zu Sicherheit, Governance, Datenschutz, Compliance und verantwortungsvoller KI im Unternehmenskontext.
Teamfähigkeit, Freude an Innovation und sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Eine oder mehrere passende Microsoft Zertifizierungen, zum Beispiel AI-900, AI-102, AB-100, AB-620 oder AB-730, oder die Bereitschaft, diese zeitnah zu erwerben.

Hey, wir sind Skaylink.

Begleite uns auf unserer Cloud Journey!

Als Part of Vodafone bringen wir unsere Cloud-DNA und Innovationskraft ein. Gemeinsam treiben wir zentrale Cloud- und Transformationsprojekte voran. Von Cloud-Migrationen über Security-Lösungen bis hin zu Modern-Work-Projekten schaffen wir spürbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kund*innen. Dabei nutzen wir Synergien und bündeln unsere Stärken. So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien.

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen.

Bei uns zählen deine Expertise, deine Leidenschaft und deine Motivation, etwas zu bewegen. Unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen machen uns stark. Sie schaffen den Raum, in dem du dich einbringen und weiterentwickeln kannst.

Wenn du nicht nur mitlaufen, sondern wirklich etwas bewegen willst, bist du bei uns richtig.

Was du von uns hast

🎯 Purpose
– Deine Expertise einsetzen (in Projekten bei re­nom­mierten Unternehmen wie BMW Group, Henkel oder KWS)

🌍 Flexibilität
– Deine Balance finden (u. a. Workation, Urlaubsflexibilisierung)

📖 Entwicklung
– Ankommen und Weiterkommen (u. a. Skaylink Campus, Entwicklungsgespräche, regelmäßige Befragungen der Mitarbeitenden)

🏖️ Erholung
– Kraft tanken (u. a. 30 Tage Urlaub, 24. + 31.12 frei, Sabbatical)

🚲 Mobilität
– Von A nach B kommen (u. a. BusinessBike, Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket)

💻 Ausstattung
– Die Qual der Wahl (Apple/Windows, Firmenhandy)

💪 Unterstützung
– Fühl dich wohl (u. a. Employee Referral Program, Corporate Benefits, Arbeitsplatzbrille, jährlich 5 bezahlte Kind-krank-Tage)

🏆 Events
– Zusammenkommen und Feiern (u. a. Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeier, Teamevents, Cross-Company Tech-Talks)

🧩 Miteinander
– We are Skaylink!

Du + Skaylink = Perfect Match?

Dann bewirb dich – auch falls du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst! Wir benötigen nur deinen Lebenslauf und sind schon ganz gespannt darauf, von dir zu lesen.

jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide.

WP Engine empowers companies and agencies of all sizes to build, power, manage, and optimize their WordPress websites and applications with confidence. Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

The Manager of Customer Success is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to achieve high customer retention and superior net revenue retention (NRR). This role requires a strong focus on daily operational excellence, process adherence, and driving measurable improvements in the customer experience across specific segments or territories. An ideal Manager will be a hands-on, highly organized leader who thrives on improving team efficiency, ongoing value driven enablement and achieving measurable business results at a fast pace. The ideal candidate inspires their team and demonstrates a relentless focus on driving customer outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Coaching

Build & Scale: Build, scale and lead our rapidly growing team, continuing the development of a culture of teamwork, high performance and growth in our Success team.
Performance Management & Development: Lead day-to-day operations, goal setting, career development, performance management, and growth of team members. Directly manage a team of CSMs, conducting regular 1:1s, performance reviews, leveraging Gong and providing direct coaching and feedback on customer engagement, risk mitigation, and renewal strategy.
Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and a leader, helping to develop the skills of the team, so they are able to achieve their metrics and career goals. Supporting and advising new and experienced Customer Success team members in strategies to develop lasting relationships with customers.
Workflow Build & Execution: Ensure the team consistently follows established customer success playbooks, health scoring methodologies, and escalation procedures.

Operational Excellence & Execution

Retention & Growth Targets: Drive the team’s execution of retention programs to meet monthly and quarterly Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) targets. Accountable for the delivery of the team retention and growth targets and associated Key Performance Indicators.
Risk Management & Escalations: Oversee the proactive identification and mitigation of at-risk accounts, ensuring timely activation of executive engagement and stabilization plans. Lead the response to customer escalations, ensuring related actions are followed through to resolution with the applicable team members.
Data-Driven Decisions: Manage and report on key operational metrics for the team, including Customer Health Scores, Sales Pipeline, Risk Trends, Churn Forecasting, & Success plans. Analyse customer and performance data to make informed decisions about operational and procedural changes.
Tool Utilization: Ensure 100% adherence to CRM and CS platform usage, maintaining data integrity for accurate forecasting and executive reporting.

Customer Advocacy & Feedback Loop

Customer Engagement Strategy: Create customer advocacy and trust by implementing a consultative solution lead approach.
Voice of the Customer (VoC): Systematically collect and synthesize customer feedback and pain points from the team and deliver actionable insights to the Director/VP and Product teams.
Process Improvement & Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with Operations and other managers to identify friction points in the customer journey (e.g., onboarding handoffs, technical support) and propose solutions to improve overall efficiency. Partner with the Director of Customer Success and other global collaborators to further refine the structure, process, systems, and resources to optimally support our customers and team. There is huge scope for creativity and impact in this role.
Renewal Support: Directly assist CSMs with complex renewal negotiations and manage customer escalations that require managerial oversight.

Your Background and Expertise

Experience: 4-6 years' experience leading a customer experience or customer success team. 2+ years of formal experience directly managing and leading a customer-facing team.
Operational & Technical Skills: Demonstrated proficiency with Customer Success platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Catalyst) and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) for managing customer health and forecasting. Proficient in Customer Success best practice and methodologies.
Results-Driven & Analytical: Results driven, able to empower their team to focus on strategic goals and critical metric delivery. Ability to analyse and interpret data to optimise performance, increase customer retention and make data-driven decisions.
Leadership & Change Management: Excellent leadership, interpersonal and problem solving/decision making skills. Can lead change, comfortable with ambiguity and able to support the team by building their resilience and managing emotions. Experience working effectively with all levels of management. Experience handling critical customer concerns.
Execution: Ability to lead multiple projects while maintaining strict attention to details. Ability to adapt quickly to new or changing business requirements.
Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in small and large groups.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.

The Perks and Benefits

Company Stock Options (Every employee is an owner in the company)
Great Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance)
Fertility Benefits (IVF/Fertility drug coverage)
HSA Company contribution $750 for employee / $1500 for family
401(k) with a 4% match
Disability Insurance
Paid Family and Caregiver’s Leave
Employee Assistance Program
Generous Vacation Time (Who doesn’t like time off)
One-time $500 payment to set up your home office
4 Company Wellness Days a year
1 floating holiday
Pet Insurance
On-going education through LinkedIn Learning, Workday Learning and our Career Growth Portal

At WP Engine, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. WP Engine is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

We believe that compensation should be reflective of the impact you have within the organization relative to the market value of your role. The cash compensation package above includes base pay plus on-target commission for employees in eligible roles. Sales incentive plans are uncapped with significant earning potential. jobs.title: Manager, Customer Success - Enterprise
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The hiring organization is seeking a Manager, Customer Success - Enterprise
for a full-time, remote role based in the United States. In this position, you will lead a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers responsible for a combined portfolio of Upmarket customers with annual contract values ranging from $100K to $500K, representing approximately $15M to $20M in ARR.

This role focuses on driving customer retention, adoption, value realization, and operational excellence across the portfolio while coaching and developing high-performing talent. You will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to support customer business outcomes and operational scale.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 7-8 Customer Success Managers supporting Upmarket customers.
Foster a culture of accountability, customer-centricity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Conduct regular coaching sessions, performance reviews, talent assessments, and career development conversations.
Establish clear expectations and operating rhythms that drive consistent execution and customer outcomes.
Recruit, onboard, and develop Customer Success talent while supporting organizational succession planning.
Drive strong Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and value realization across the portfolio.
Coach Customer Success Managers on account strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, success planning, renewal strategy, risk mitigation, and value delivery, ensuring ownership of the renewal process.
Ensure team members proactively identify account risks and execute mitigation strategies to protect retention.
Partner with Sales leadership to align on customer health, growth opportunities, and strategic account planning.
Maintain strong customer engagement and executive alignment across key accounts.
Own portfolio forecasting processes, renewal inspections, customer health reviews, and risk management practices.
Ensure consistent execution of success plans, Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), account reviews, and customer engagement standards.
Use data and analytics to track performance trends, drive decision-making, and champion operational improvements in efficiency, scalability, and forecast accuracy.
Drive team adoption of established Customer Success processes, tools, and best practices.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to deliver strong customer outcomes and support strategic initiatives.
Act as a voice of the customer across the organization and contribute to shaping operating models, programs, and processes.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of people leadership experience leading customer-facing teams within a SaaS organization.
8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or other customer-facing roles.
Proven track record of building, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.
Experience leading teams responsible for customer retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.
Strong understanding of SaaS business models and key metrics, including GRR, churn, forecasting, customer health, and product adoption.
Experience coaching teams on executive engagement, account strategy, value realization, and risk management.
Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.
Demonstrated ability to drive operational rigor and accountability through data-driven management practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into action.
Comfortable leveraging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve team productivity, customer insights, coaching effectiveness, and operational scale.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, team events, and company programs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading Customer Success teams supporting enterprise or upmarket SaaS customers.
Experience managing teams responsible for portfolios between $15M and $20M in ARR.
Experience within MarTech, AdTech, SalesTech, Revenue Technology, or related B2B SaaS industries.
Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Clari, Gong, and other customer success technologies.
Experience helping scale Customer Success organizations, teams, and operating models.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Salary Range: $113,400 - $150,100
per year. Actual salaries may vary based on factors including work location and experience.
Additional Compensation: Eligibility for an incentive bonus program or commission plan, and stock options subject to board approval.
Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching, paid time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and professional development support.

Equal Opportunity Employer

The organization is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants participating in any stage of the application and interview process.
